payload.body_they: {{Name}} pays close attention to how another person talks, listens, asks questions, and disagrees. Close relationships can sharpen their thinking because another person gives them something substantial to respond to. But a convincing explanation is not the same as changed behavior. {{Name}} can understand exactly why someone did something and still decide they do not want to keep living with it. What happens after the conversation matters as much as how well the conversation went.
